_note: Added 2026-09-20, not from the handoff. Story books come from each era's span in part-one.json. Prophet placement follows Fr. Malaty's Historical Map (prophets table). Job follows the handoff (patriarchal age, 1859 BC). Ruth follows the map's note inside the Judges era. Psalms, Proverbs, Ecclesiastes and Song of Songs are placed by tradition (David and Solomon), Chronicles by the kings it retells, and Lamentations at the fall of Jerusalem: those are Claude's placements, not from the map. Ezra, Nehemiah, Esther, Ezekiel, Daniel, Obadiah, Haggai, Zechariah and Malachi belong to Part Two.
later: Ezra, Nehemiah, Esther, Ezekiel, Daniel, Obadiah, Haggai, Zechariah and Malachi come after the fall of Jerusalem. They belong to Part Two.
